def settings(keys: list[str], values: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    """Overlay keys[i] -> values[i] on the defaults mode=fast, level=3.

    Returns the resulting values in the order mode, level, then the other
    keys in first-appearance order. A repeated key takes its last value.
    """
    pre keys.len() == values.len()
    post out.len() >= 2
    ex settings([], []) == ["fast", "3"]
    ex settings(["level"], ["5"]) == ["fast", "5"]
    ex settings(["color", "mode"], ["red", "slow"]) == ["slow", "3", "red"]
    ex settings(["x", "x"], ["1", "2"]) == ["fast", "3", "2"]
    mode = "fast"
    level = "3"
    extras: dict[str, str] = {}
    order: list[str] = []
    for i in range(keys.len()):
        k = keys[i]
        v = values[i]
        if k == "mode":
            mode = v.copy()
        elif k == "level":
            level = v.copy()
        else:
            if k not in extras:
                order.append(k.copy())
            extras[k.copy()] = v.copy()
    out: list[str] = [mode, level]
    for k in order:
        out.append(extras.get(k) else "")
    return out
